Subject: Request: AWS marketplace tiered bundle exception for HelioGrid co-sell

Hi Jessica / Marketplace team,

Quick note — HelioGrid is in the final stages of a co-sell commitment with us. They have agreed to a 12-month contract that includes both Redwood Hosted API and a capacity reservation for Dedicated instances. The buyer is asking us to publish a marketplace listing with a tiered bundle discount (volume tiers) to match the commercial terms they've already signed under the direct PO.

Specific ask:
- Support an exception to standard marketplace rate card to allow a tiered bundle discount: 20% off list for first $150k ARR, 30% off for next $250k, then standard rates afterward.
- Allow the offer as a private listing (HelioGrid private offer) so co-sell credits flow correctly.

Business justification:
- HelioGrid is committing to a minimum 12-month, $400k ARR.
- Closing via marketplace simplifies procurement for their procurement team and unlocks AWS co-sell support.
- Timeline: they want the marketplace listing ready to accept the private offer by next Tuesday (7/6).

I've attached the signed term sheet and current proposal (proposal_heliogrid_v2.pdf). Can you confirm what documentation AWS needs for a rate-card exception and whether a private offer is the recommended path? If approval requires escalation to Deal Desk, please confirm who I should loop in.

Thanks — appreciate a quick read.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Jessica Wu <jessica.wu@amazon.com>

Cc: AWS Marketplace Team <aws-marketplace-seller@amazon.com>, Emily Park <emily@heliogrid.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: AWS marketplace tiered bundle exception for HelioGrid co-sell

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the context and the proposal. Quick follow-ups and next steps from the Marketplace side: 

- AWS generally prefers private offers for bespoke pricing vs. public listings. Private offer + co-sell route is usually faster to get credits with the right CPT.
- For exceptions to the standard rate card (tiered discounts that deviate from our published pricing), we need:
  1) HubSpot opportunity or equivalent (please include the opportunity ID)
  2) Signed term sheet and PO / commitment language (we have the attached proposal but we also need the HubSpot record)
  3) A short business case outlining why the exception is required (partner/customer impact, ARR, co-sell influence)

I've attached a short excerpt of AWS policy for internal reference (aws_pricing_policy_excerpt.pdf).

As an alternative to a full exception, consider arranging a private offer with a negotiated discount that references the Deal Desk approval after you secure the HubSpot opp. If you want, I can put this in front of our co-sell specialist and internal Deal Desk for review — I'll need the documents above.

Can you provide the HubSpot opportunity id and confirm whether HelioGrid will sign a DocuSign PO if we can secure the private offer?

Regards,
Jessica Wu
Senior Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
Jessica.Wu@amazon.com

Attachment: aws_pricing_policy_excerpt.pdf (PDF, 84KB)

Thanks for the patience while we reviewed. Deal Desk has approved a conditional exception for the HelioGrid private offer with the following terms: 

1) Approved discount structure (private offer only): 20% off list up to $150k, then 30% off list up to $400k total ARR for the first 12 months.
2) Approval applies only if customer signs a DocuSign PO referencing the private offer within 10 business days of the private offer being created.
3) Offer must be configured as a private marketplace offer tied to HelioGrid's account; public listing not permitted under this exception.
4) Deal Desk requires a cap: total discounted commitment no greater than $400k for the 12-month term; no retroactive credits.
5) Redwood finance must submit the billing flow confirmation (cc Laura) before the offer goes live.

I've attached the Deal Desk decision memo for your records (dealdesk_decision_20260702.pdf) and included a DocuSign link for the PO. Once the PO is in place, Jessica — please advise the best next step on AWS side to create the private offer and route co-sell credits.
